utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s Thursday at the cafe now, so that should work better than Tuesday at the library. I can help pick a book or figure out a time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me—thanks, Jules. Let me know the book and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll send around a couple book options and confirm the time at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I haven’t pinned down the novel yet, sorry — I’m still leaning a bit mystery, maybe. I’ll ask around and confirm the time for next Thursday soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries — mystery sounds like the direction, and I’ll keep an ear out for the title while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll circle back once I’ve settled the title and time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, of course — no worries at all. If you hear any book club updates, I’d love to catch up later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll let you know if anything changes, and we can keep it off school pickup day. Thanks for understanding.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate it. Just let me know whenever you hear more about the book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. It’s now Thursday at the cafe, so I’ll see how I’m feeling.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No pressure, Uli — hope you’re feeling up for it, and if not, we’ll catch you next time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it — I’ll let you know if I can make Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what book are we reading, and what time next Thursday evening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So is the book club actually picking the new read soon, or is that still just a maybe? And can you confirm what time next Thursday evening is?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s decide the book soon and set a firm time for next Thursday evening. I’d like the exact time and read confirmed so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—if the book club needs any tools or a hand with setup, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I think we’re set for Thursday at the cafe. I’ll bring the book and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — Thursday at the cafe works for me. Just holler if you need anything at all.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s now on Thursday at the cafe instead of Tuesday at the library. I’d also love to hear what the club’s reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — Thursday at the cafe works, and I’d love to tell you what we’ve been reading. Come with me and I’ll fill you in!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll come with you. I’m curious what you’ve all been reading lately.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s moved to Thursday at the cafe now. Same book, just different day and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Thursday at the cafe, same book. I’ll keep that location in mind.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. See you Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — do you know the exact time and address yet? I just want to make sure I can get there without any mix-up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not yet — I’m still confirming the exact time and cafe address, but it’s definitely Thursday now. I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll wait for the exact details, then. Just let me know as soon as you’ve got the time and cafe address.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss the update, so please remind me if I forget.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll check with the book club and remind you what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, are we still meeting at your place, and do you still want me to bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still on at my place, and I’ve got the snacks covered—just bring yourself and the list if you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll just bring myself, and I’ll bring the list if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check the room and time first, and I’ll ask about the new book too if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, that’d be super helpful—room and time first, and I’m curious about the new book too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the room and time first, and I’ll ask about the new book too if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the book club and let you know what we decide.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — and just a reminder, it’s Thursday at the cafe now, not Tuesday at the library.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — thanks for the update, I’ll let the book club know it’s Thursday at the cafe now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking on the room and time for the book club, Noah. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — I might miss the update, so please remind me when you have it. Appreciate you checking on the room and time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Noah — I’ll remind you as soon as I have the room and time. Thanks for being patient!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thursday at the cafe works for me—what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — I’m still waiting on Oren for the final time, but Thursday at the cafe sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just let me know when Oren confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check which mystery novel Oren is leaning toward first, and then we can find a time that works around school pickup. Also, yes—if we’re still meeting at my place, snacks would be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — let’s check Oren’s mystery pick first, and the book club is now Thursday at the cafe, not Tuesday at the library. Snacks would still be great if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Thursday at the cafe works for me, and I’ll check Oren’s mystery pick first. I can still bring snacks if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they’re meeting this Thursday, and I should definitely come with you. If they need anything set up, I can help too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Nell — it’s Thursday at the cafe now. Thanks for offering to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll head over to the cafe and help with setup. Just let me know what needs doing when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’m usually late, but I’d still love to come. Just let me know what you all decide.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — it’s Thursday at the cafe now, and I’ll confirm the exact time for you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Just send me the time when you know, and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and extra tea ready for book club—did you want me to bring anything else, Eli?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, that’s plenty—thank you. I’m all set for next Thursday evening at your place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll see you next Thursday evening at my place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I’ll check the next meeting date and whether we’re doing snacks this time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check and get back to you, Mara — if there’s a snacks plan, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — I’ll keep you posted about Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at your place for book club, and should I bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, we’re still on at my place, and snacks would be great — could you let me know what you’re bringing? I’m just trying to keep the timing and table space sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can bring some fruit and crackers. I’ll text you if I need to adjust anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I think it’s coming up really soon, so you won’t have to guess much longer. I’ll tell you as soon as I hear what they pick.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still not confirmed yet, right? Just let me know the title and the time when you hear for sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, still not confirmed yet—but I’ll pass along the title and time the minute I hear for sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on for Thursday at 7 at 14 Maple Street. Bring snacks if you’d like—nothing else needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll bring snacks. Just glad it isn’t school pickup day.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — snacks are always welcome, and I’m glad the timing works for you.
